main_reference: Current user Plane233 C01, actually viewed; true open-L boundary lengths paired red/blue, no source partition. Migrated to detached span annotations to preserve the physical-paper interpretation.
migration_groups: The board has a true four-cell bottom run. Compare it with the full four-cell lower arm of C.
C has a true four-cell bottom run, occupying the entire board width in a horizontal placement.
The lower two units of the original board right boundary supply a real two-cell height comparison. It is an open boundary interval, not an internal cut.
C has a true two-cell vertical end. Compare two copies of its 4 by 2 bounding span with the 4 by 3 board, while the unchanged notch still permits interlocking.
historical_difference: Plane218 has no saved tested prior design. Old prescreen only established exhaustive placements and reported no clear trap. This proposal uses the independently verified 4 by 2 bounding-span/interlock distinction. It does not reuse Plane233 C pixels or assert coverage of all twelve cells.
limitation: Detachment is a deliberate adaptation needed by the physical-piece semantics. It is subject to parent independent review.
